title: dns: add semantic validation for SVCB parameters
description:
## Summary

Add semantic validation checks for SVCB/HTTPS parameters in `dissect_svc_params()` based on RFC 9460.

This adds warnings for:

* duplicate SvcParamKeys
* non-ascending key ordering
* duplicate keys inside `mandatory`
* `mandatory` keys missing from the RR
* `no-default-alpn` used without `alpn`

The existing malformed handling and offset resynchronization behavior are kept unchanged.

## Testing

Built and tested with `tshark`.

Verified expert warnings using crafted HTTPS/SVCB DNS packets for:

* duplicate keys
* invalid key ordering

Also verified that packet dissection continues correctly without parser desync.

## Files changed

* `epan/dissectors/packet-dns.c`
* Attached `svcb-duplicate-key.pcap` for reproducing the validation warnings.

  [svcb-duplicate-key.pcap](/uploads/75c45376bbff0dcb4e711cd0b7de5205/svcb-duplicate-key.pcap)
